text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. Your checkout is still open, so I'm writing myself rather than sending a banner. One thing before the details: the Autumn Sale price holds only while the sale runs, and sizes sell through before it closes.

The 45% Autumn Sale is already in your total, in USD, no conversion surprises. If it's easier to spread it out, Shop Pay splits it into instalments at the last step, and PayPal is there too.

If you stopped because of the size: check the size guide on each product page; between sizes, take both — easy returns on the one that doesn't fit.

Delivery takes 7 to 10 days; shipping is $8, free from $150. And if it isn't right when it arrives, you have thirty days at home and returns are easy. That's the whole point of it.

Back to your checkout: {{ event.extra.checkout_url }}

Warmly,
Claire
Nora Lanelle
